work_item.role: W1 public-evidence discovery and neutral admission

discovery_pass.method: Direction-blind admission of both frozen model-specific Scaffold-Effects snapshots. Each model condition covers the same source-selected 50-task Terminal-Bench Pro slice across Goose, OpenCode and OpenHands-SDK under Harbor/Daytona with a source-declared 40-turn budget. Correctness uses the source collector's positive-reward `solved` field and attempted denominator; exception-first failure categories and token/cost telemetry are retained only as auxiliary source fields and are not normalized or interpreted by W1.

source_known_dimensions: same source-selected 50 Terminal-Bench Pro tasks stratified across eight archetypes
one trial per task per harness
Daytona sandbox family with identical task Docker image per task
900-second per-trial agent cap in committed harness configs
same frozen snapshot collection surface with task-level telemetry
explicit_unknown_or_nonidentical_dimensi: Goose/OpenHands use an OpenAI-compatible OpenRouter endpoint while OpenCode uses its native OpenRouter provider path
immutable harness package/source revisions are not preserved by the study
harness-specific system prompts, tool surfaces and retry/control policies intentionally differ as the studied independent variable
token accounting differs by harness and is not normalized by W1
some trials have source outcome `unknown`; W1 preserves the attempted denominator used by the source aggregate

non_admission_dispositions.reason: Primary telemetry explicitly uses different accounting paths: Goose can rely on a harness-specific stream-log reconstruction with lump-sum tokens, while other harnesses expose richer token splits and coverage. W1 stores source-reported token fields as auxiliary provenance but does not create a normalized efficiency metric or ranking.

non_admission_dispositions.surface: Scaffold-Effects failure-category counts as correctness counts
non_admission_dispositions.reason: Primary collector computes `solved` from positive reward but classifies failure category exception-first. A positive-reward trial with an exception can therefore contribute to `solved` without being categorized as `SOLVED`. W1 preserves the source `solved/pass_rate` aggregate and the post-hoc diagnostics separately rather than reconciling them.
